Chapter 347: Chapter 9: The Ambitious Tianqing Alliance Leader (Happy New Year)

Chapter 347: Chapter 9: The Ambitious Tianqing Alliance Leader (Happy New Year)

Outside the world.

The Tianqing Alliance Leader held a stone sword in his hand, from which an invisible force emanated, blocking the many injuries coming from all directions.

“Insects, you forced my hand.”

In the distance, the Ancestral Demon Tree was furious—upon closer inspection, one could discern a faint sword mark on its trunk.

Clearly, in the recent battle with the Tianqing Alliance Leader, it had not only failed to gain the upper hand but had also suffered some losses.

“And what if I did force you?”

...

The Tianqing Alliance Leader kept a calm expression; the Ancestral Demon Tree inherently stood on the opposing side of Tianqing World—irreconcilable.

“Since that’s the case…”

The Ancestral Demon Tree’s countless black vines swayed, vaguely shifting the space of thousands of miles around it.

“What is this?”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader’s expression changed slightly, as the surging demonic force was already coming at him tangibly.

“World Sword!”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader gripped the long sword in his hand; with his power, he had been able to fight against a Foreign Evil God for so long, thanks to this World Sword nurtured by Tianqing World for countless years.

Although the World Sword is called a ‘sword’, its defensive capability is also extremely terrifying,

At least since the Ancestral Demon Tree invaded, the Tianqing Alliance Leader had remained unscathed under the protection of the World Sword.

Of course.

The potency of the World Sword is related to the distance from Tianqing World.

The closer to Tianqing World, the more powerful the World Sword becomes.

Conversely, the weaker it becomes.

“This is… my world…”

The demonic force filling the space of thousands of miles quickly diminished, space twisted, and instantly moved the Tianqing Alliance Leader closer.

Immediately, the forces of demonic energy continuously intertwined and collided, forming the illusory image of a world.

“What is this?”

The Tianqing Alliance Leader’s expression grew solemn; such a tactic had never been used by the Ancestral Demon Tree before.

It could be foreseen that this must be one of the Ancestral Demon Tree’s trump cards.

Boom, thunderous.

The immense power of the Demon World began to press down, and the Tianqing Alliance Leader, unchanging in response to myriad changes, held the World Sword and activated its power to protect himself.

…

In the distance.

The twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs of the Tianqing Alliance watched the Tianqing Alliance Leader’s battle with the Ancestral Demon Tree from afar.

“Is the Alliance Leader being too confident, asking us not to intervene and letting him confront the Foreign Evil God alone?”

One of the Vice Alliance Hierarchs couldn’t help but frown.

Indeed, the Tianqing Alliance Leader, wielding the World Sword, was renowned for slaying evil and being impervious to myriad laws.

But that was a Foreign Evil God, a fearsome entity that had almost breached into the Tianqing World single-handedly.

In the face of such a being, no precaution could be too great, and voluntarily giving up their advantage to fight one-on-one seemed somewhat…

Foolish?

Although the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs together could not inflict any damage on the Ancestral Demon Tree,

At least they could restrain it, and in crucial moments could prove quite useful.

“The Alliance Leader must have his reasons.”

“If I’m not mistaken, is the Alliance Leader testing that Foreign Evil God?”

Another Vice Alliance Hierarch mused.

If the Tianqing Alliance Leader and the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs joined forces, that Foreign Evil God would likely not engage in battle, much less exert full power.

But now, with only the Alliance Leader alone, that Foreign Evil God might entertain the idea of severely injuring or even killing the Alliance Leader, and might strike with full force.

And in a full-strength battle, it would be easier to discern the true extent of the adversary’s capabilities.

“This is not good.”

“What tactic did that Evil God use to ensnare the Alliance Leader?”

Just then, the twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs saw the Ancestral Demon Tree surrounded by dark demonic force, and immediately, the Tianqing Alliance Leader was enveloped within it.

“The Alliance Leader has the World Sword to protect him; he should be fine, right?”

“Alas, the Alliance Leader is truly taking a risk. If something goes wrong, our Tianqing World will no longer have the power to resist in front of that Evil God.”

…

The twelve Vice Alliance Hierarchs exchanged words, their tones filled with worry.

…

Deep within the Black Mist Mountain Range.

Right now, Lin Yuan was deeply immersed in enlightenment.

Seven Demon Beast Kings stood guard at various directions of the Black Mist Mountain Range, ensuring that Lin Yuan was not disturbed by any external factors.

[Your insight is exceptional, pondering the ‘Void’s Root’, perfecting the Martial Tao Evolution System Seventh Stage…]

…

[Your insight is exceptional, pondering the ‘Void’s Root’, perfecting the Martial Tao Evolution System Seventh Stage…]

…

[Your insight is exceptional, pondering the ‘Void’s Root’, perfecting the Martial Tao Evolution System Seventh Stage…]

…

Lots of inspirations about the Martial Tao Evolution System Seventh Stage were absorbed and utilized by Lin Yuan.

The many talents released by the Ancestral Demon Tree for Lin Yuan were also integrated into the Martial Tao Evolution System.

For instance, ‘Void’s Root’: a capability that greatly strengthens the survival ability of martial arts evolvers in later stages, allowing for prolonged existence in the void.

Other evolvers, accidentally entering the void and straying from their world without an energy source, would either perish from spatial turmoil or ‘starve to death’.

However, a Seventh Rank martial arts evolver, once reaching the level of a Marquis, would possess a capability similar to that of the Void’s Root, allowing survival in the void.

“Martial Tao Evolution System, unique, yet accommodating myriad laws, like the Physical Body Divine Skills of the Body Cultivation lineage in the Immortal Tao World, or the many talents of this Ancestral Demon Tree.”

“As long as they are compatible, they can all be incorporated into the Martial Tao…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts surged, silently reflecting.

As long as the foundation of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path remained unchanged, no matter how myriad its transformations, it would still be the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, still capable of providing the sustenance for Lin Yuan’s ‘Ultimate Leap’.
